reason: I'm locked into a 3-year card deal with an exit fee, and my techs know my current system. The 60-day trial next to it is tempting, but I've heard 'cheaper fees' promises before and I want to see my own numbers first.
objection: Card fees are where the real money is. Is yours really cheaper than what I have now, once I count the exit fee on my contract? I won't move until I see that on paper.
would_change_my_mind: A salon owner I know, in my Facebook group, tells me they run it and their card fees went down. And the fee check on my own 3 months of statements shows me clearly better, with the exit fee counted.
